invariant.subject: leap
invariant.source: Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) is based on International Atomic Time (TAI), but it is adjusted by leap seconds
invariant.relation: Why atomic time and civil time diverge

candidates: The story is about the relationship between atomic time, represented by International Atomic Time (TAI), and civil time, represented by Coordinated Universal Time (UTC). UTC is based on TAI but is adjusted by leap seconds, so the reader should understand that the two are connected but do not remain identical.
- **Development:** Explain their supported relationship: UTC is based on TAI and is adjusted by leap seconds.
- **Context:** Introduce TAI and UTC as the two time standards at the center of the story.
